name: Does the dry Denver climate affect how paint touch ups dry and blend?

mainEntity.name: Does the dry Denver climate affect how paint touch ups dry and blend?

acceptedAnswer.text: In dry, elevated climates like the Denver metro area, indoor humidity is naturally low, which accelerates water-based paint drying times. While faster drying speeds up the patching process, it also reduces open working time, meaning paint edges dry rapidly. A finish contractor must feather edges swiftly to avoid visible lap marks and ensure the new paint blends evenly into the existing dry wall texture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, Denver's dry air speeds up drying times, which requires fast feathering to prevent paint edges from setting too quickly and leaving lap marks.
